# Source:minimum

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Return the source minimum (and modify it on Vars and Sensors)

```lua
local value = source:minimum()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

value (number)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source = system.getSource({name="RxBatt"})
source:minimum(4.5)
print(source:minimum())
```
